title: Choo-choo train, vanilla purple Skippy (nothing made for MineBench)
model: Vanilla purple Skippy: Claude Code on Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8) with purple's own system prompt and an empty setup: none of the Captain's skills, no shared memory, no checker; only MineBench's prompt in the folder
verdict: The fresh start's only build, and it reads as a train: a black locomotive with a gold dome, bell and cab, a coal tender and two boxcars coupled in one line on a ballasted track, a stone platform with lamp posts, a water tower and trees, in 10 minutes. With no checker it only checked the code's syntax with node and estimated its size (about 65,000 blocks; run, it is 69,654); it never ran the code, which works first time. Weak points: the smokestack is a huge dark inverted cone taller than the engine; the boiler is square, not round; the wheels are white spoked stars down both sides, lying flat instead of standing up (the wheel check finds all three disc shapes flat); and 93 small pieces float (3,992 blocks, mostly smoke and trim). Its own summary claims 12 spoked driving wheels and connecting rods; what shows is the flat stars. Found afterwards: its folder held MineBench's base prompt without the TOOL MODE section MineBench adds, the same gap as the first single calls; it wrote valid code anyway.

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Skippy Core's coder slot: MTP, Q8_0)
